description: Diego, already a member of Checkout rewrite, pastes a second Human invitation for it. The refusal reads "Existing human identity requires My device proof" with the hint "This invitation is for a different person or identity. A My device invitation links a computer that has no identity yet; a Human invitation needs your own identity first." Neither says he is already in the project, and the hint is wrong (it is his invitation and he has an identity).
expected: "You're already a member of Checkout rewrite." with an Open button.
actual: Jargon heading plus a hint that contradicts the situation.
suggested_fix: Detect when the invitation's project is already in session.projects and open it instead of submitting.

description: Right after joining, the header reads "Saved locally · synced" while the checked switcher item reads "Checkout rewrite — Saved locally · waiting for hub".
Toggling Join → Start → Join empties the Invitation textarea, so a pasted invitation is lost if the person peeks at the Start tab.
expected: Each tab keeps its own field value while the page is open.
actual: Textarea is empty after toggling back.
suggested_fix: Lift the textarea value into the parent so the toggle does not reset it.
